column2: Volt set the scooter's clock right before this test, so the scooter may not be keeping the time it's given. Until that's solved, a smart plug is a safer timer. Report an issue with diagnostics so we can look into it.

column4: Volt set the scooter's clock just before this test, so the scooter perhaps does not keep the time it gets. Until it is solved, a smart plug is a safer timer. Report a problem with diagnostic data, so we can investigate it.
